name: Search API Workspaces
description: Adds workspace awareness to Search API so indexed content and queries respect the active Workspaces content revision.
project_description:
This module provides a Search API datasource plugin to index workspace specific content, and views fields and a filter to list them.

It creates items with the ID pattern of {entity_id}:{langcode}:{revision_id}. The functionality included focuses on inherited content from parent workspaces,

providing a workspace association field and filter to allow filtering based on the currently selected workspace, and return all associated workspace revisions.

 Currently using this patch https://www.drupal.org/project/drupal/issues/2925890#comment-12791739 to resolve an issue with views filter placeholders.
